name: LiDAR balanced visual quality
notes: FloraWorld whole-map canopy uses authored near/far thresholds, so mesh LOD scale is 1 instead of the legacy 4. TSR 75%, virtual-shadow bias 1, four directional shadow rays and exclusion of non-Nanite foliage from coarse pages retained. Ray-traced effects and Lumen reflection policy follow project settings. CPU optimizations, 0.5 ms mud upload budget and 120 fps cap retained; 60 fps is the next measured target; the 120 fps cap is retained for headroom measurement. Full vegetation placement, native grass and driving physics retained. See FloraWorld review-report for actual runtime settings and offscreen comparative timings; standalone target-device performance remains unverified.
